Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, I begin my speech by praising You
And I speak with adoration for You
And I glorify You, though there is no limit to Your praise

Arabic text: وَ اُثْنِيْ عَلَيْكَ وَمَنْ يَبْلُغُ غَايَةَ ثَنَائِكَ وَاَمَدَ مَجْدِكَ
Translation: And I extol You, but who can reach the extent of Your praise and the limit of Your glory?
How can Your creation fully comprehend the essence of Your glory?

Arabic text: وَاَيَّ زَمَنٍ لَمْ تَكُنْ مَمْدُوْحًا بِفَضْلِكَ
Translation: And in what time were You not praised for Your grace,
Repeatedly forgiving the sinners with Your clemency?
The dwellers of Your earth have abandoned Your obedience,
Yet You have been compassionate to them through Your generosity,

Arabic text: يَا لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ
Translation: O there is no god but You, the Benefactor,
